rows.title: Manage templates page, empty, read from the user's stored templates
rows.detail: No real service has notification templates today. Design Release 2.1 adds a Manage templates page that lists a trader's saved templates. This first slice builds the page and the store it reads from: the heading, intro line, phase banner, the 'My templates' heading and the results count, built from GOV.UK Frontend components. Templates are stored by the animals backend and kept between sessions, with no seeded examples (c-183). With nothing saved yet the page shows a zero count and an empty list. The page's path follows the real service's conventions, not the prototype's (c-258). Later rows add creating, viewing, using, changing and deleting templates on top of this page and store.
acceptanceCriteria: A signed-in user opening Manage templates sees a page titled 'Manage templates - Import notification service - GOV.UK' with the H1 'Manage templates' (prototype:dr2-1-source dashboard-templates.html:9,43; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T1 action 24; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:15-19; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 103)

Under the heading the page shows the line 'Select, manage or create new notification templates' (prototype:dr2-1-source dashboard-templates.html:44; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T1 action 24; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:19)
Manage templates has no Back link: the page starts with its heading (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T1 action 24)

The page shows the Alpha phase banner 'This is a new service. Help us improve it and give your feedback by email.', whose feedback link goes to the same feedback address the service's other pages use, never '#' (prototype:dr2-1-source dashboard-templates.html:12-17)
The templates are listed under an H2 'My templates' (prototype:dr2-1-source dashboard-templates.html:58; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T1 action 24; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:21)

With no saved templates the page shows 'Show 0 of 0 results' and an empty list, with no empty-state message, no filter, no search and no pagination control (prototype:dr2-1-source dashboard-templates.html:61,77-81; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T1 action 24; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:22)
A user who has never saved a template sees no example templates: the list holds only templates that user has really saved (ruling:sam-2026-10-07 claim 10; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 125; c-183)

The page is built from GOV.UK Frontend components (the standard heading, caption and phase banner) rather than the prototype's custom app-dr2-* blocks, and renders as the design does (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T1 action 24 main outerHTML)

sources.ref: claim 10 (persistence overrides the prototype's session store)
claims 103 (templates pages named by page, not path) and 125 (c-183 kept)

rows.gate: Look at where templates live and the shape of the stored template record (owner, set it was made in, title, date created, the notification answers it holds), and at the Manage templates page pattern: every later templates row builds its pages and its saves on these.
notes: Re-distil (9 October ruling): rewritten to the current requirements. The page is named by page, never by the prototype's path (c-258, ruling claim 103). req-1310 (templates stored by the animals backend, no seeded templates) moves here from the save row: the empty, unseeded list is where it is first seen, and the store is built here; its kept-between-sessions half is observed again in the save row once a template can exist. req-1295 (Templates marked current) stays with the navigation row (inc-152).

Combines the page chrome (req-1291, req-1292, req-1294, req-1296), the list heading, count and empty state (req-1297, req-1298, req-1300), the GOV.UK component rule (req-1306), which every later templates page also follows, and the store (req-1310): one page, one set-up.

Templates belong to both sets (live animals and germinal products, ruling claim 51 and 127), so the Manage templates, template page and delete pages are not set pages; the existing decision keeps them in the animals frontend beside the live-animals set's features, where the theme already draws them. The plan may place the folder outside sets/live-animals if the germinal set needs to reach it; say so in the plan.

rows.title: Templates marked current in the service navigation on every templates page
rows.detail: On every templates page (Manage templates, Enter template name, the template page and the delete and discard confirmations) the service navigation marks 'Templates' as the current item. The navigation item itself is the layout area's work in the same row.
acceptanceCriteria: On Manage templates, Templates is the item marked as current in the service navigation, and Dashboard and Address book are not (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/layouts/main.html:79-95; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T1 action 24 .govuk-service-navigation; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:23)
notes: Combiner: merge into inc-152 (the layout area's 'Templates item in the service navigation on both frontends', req-965), as the earlier combiner did; it already observes the current marking on every templates page. Only the Manage templates page exists when inc-152 lands; each later templates row's page inherits the same layout, so its current marking is seen as those pages land.

rows.title: Start a template: notification type, template name and origin in template mode
rows.detail: A trader starts a new template from Manage templates. 'Create new template' asks the notification type question, offering only the types whose service stores templates (Live animals and Germinal products, ruling 9 October claims 127 and 128), then a template name page, then opens Origin of the import in template mode, where the page carries a 'Template' caption with the template's name. The name is optional and unvalidated. Starting a template leaves the user's draft notifications untouched. This row sets the template-mode pattern (caption, buttons and back link) every later template-mode question page follows.
acceptanceCriteria: Manage templates has a primary 'Create new template' button, a link styled as a button; following it shows 'What are you importing?' under the caption 'About the consignment', with only the radios Live animals and Germinal products (semen, ova, embryos), none preselected, a 'Continue' button, a Back link to Manage templates and no 'Template' caption (prototype:dr2-1-source dashboard-templates.html:50-53; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 actions 4-11; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:20, 124-127; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 127-128; c-220; c-265)
Continuing with no choice shows the page's usual error, whose error summary link moves focus to the first radio (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 11; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 106)

Continuing from the type question with either type goes to the template name page, titled 'Enter template name - Import notification service - GOV.UK', with the caption 'Create a new template', the H1 'Enter template name', one text input labelled by the H1 with the visually hidden label 'Enter template name', and no hint (prototype:dr2-1-source create-template.html:8,30-45; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 23; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:128-136)

The template name page has a 'Save and continue' button and a 'Cancel and return to manage templates' link to Manage templates (prototype:dr2-1-source create-template.html:48-55; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 23; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:137)

The template name page's Back link goes to the type question when a type has been chosen, and to Manage templates otherwise (prototype:dr2-1-source create-template back link; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 23; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:138)

A blank name moves on to Origin of the import with no error, and no length, character or duplicate-name rule is applied; spaces around a name are trimmed (prototype:dr2-1-source create-template.html form novalidate; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T10 actions 11-13; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:174-179)

Going back to the name page part way through creating a template shows the name already entered; starting another new template shows it empty (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-031; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-114)

After a Live animals choice, Origin of the import shows a 'Template' caption with the template name above the caption 'About the consignment', asks the same questions with the same hints and guidance as for a notification (country search, region of origin, internal reference), offers only 'Save and continue' with no Cancel link, and its Back link returns to the template name page (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 actions 30-38, T11 action 14; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:146-147)

Starting and naming a template creates no notification and changes none: the user's draft notifications on the dashboard are the same before and after (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 125; c-183; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:140-142)
rows.gate: Look at how template mode shows on a question page (the 'Template' caption and name, which buttons and links show, where Back goes), where a template in progress is held, and how the type question hands a germinal choice on: every later template-mode page, and the germinal set's template mode (req-1876), copies this.
notes: Re-distil (9 October ruling): the type question now offers only Live animals and Germinal products (c-220, c-265; the earlier criterion listing the plants types is withdrawn), its error links to the first radio and its field name is the service's (claim 106); paths, ?from= markers and field names are the service's (c-258); the user's other drafts are left untouched (c-183).

Combines the start of template creation: the button (req-1293), the type question in template mode (req-1313, req-1314), the name page (req-1316 to req-1318, req-1320 to req-1323) and the first template-mode question page (req-1324, req-1325). They are one journey a reviewer walks once; split, none can be seen alone.

Germinal: choosing Germinal products is observed here only as far as the template name page. What a germinal template asks after its name (the germinal set's origin and pages in template mode) is req-1876, in the germinal area's row, built in the germinal theme's copies of these pages once the germinal set exists (ruling claims 6, 14, 58). Keeping it apart keeps every criterion here observable before the germinal theme lands.

Combiner: the start-and-origin area's req-010 (template mode on the type question) is the same page; keep it in this row as before. The type question lives in the INS front door (c-007, ruling claim 126); its template mode hands off to the animals frontend's name page. Backend is listed so the plan can hold the template in progress in the template store rather than as a notification; if the plan holds it elsewhere, the backend carries no change in this row. The 'Template' caption and template-mode save actions change the shared caption and save-actions chrome every question page uses.

rows.title: The template's task list and 'What are you importing?' in template mode
rows.detail: While a template is being created, 'What are you importing?' returns to the template's own task list, which is headed 'Template tasklist', shows a 'Template' tag and the template name, has five sections with no Documents section, and ends with 'Review template' and 'Return to manage templates'. A template never offers documents or a declaration; the prototype's redirects guarding those addresses are not built (c-264).
acceptanceCriteria: While a new template is being created, 'What are you importing?' shows the 'Template' caption and name, has a Back link to Origin of the import, and offers 'Save and continue', 'Save and return to overview' and a 'Cancel and return to overview' link to the template's task list (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 43)

Saving 'What are you importing?' in template mode returns to the template's task list instead of going on to the main import reason (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 actions 46-49; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:145-148)

The template's task list and its question pages show a grey 'Template' tag followed by the template's name in the status strip, in place of the draft status and notification reference (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 52; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:92, 149)

The template's task list is headed 'Template tasklist' instead of 'Notification tasklist', and keeps the 'Overview' H1 and the 'Your commodities' figures for animals and packages (0 and 0 before any are entered) (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 52; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:93)

The template's task list has five sections, '1. About the consignment', '2. Description of the goods', '3. Transport and arrival', '4. Consignment parties' and '5. Contact address', with no Documents section and no 'Upload documents' task (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 52; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:94-96)

A live animals template's tasks are Where is this consignment coming from?, What are you importing?, Main import reason, Commodity details, Identification details, Additional details, Arrival details, Transport details, Roles and addresses (hint 'Consignor or Exporter, Consignee, Importer and Place of Destination') and Contact address for this consignment, each opening its question page (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 52; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 103)
Each task shows a green 'Complete' tag when answered and a blue 'To do' tag otherwise (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 52)

The task list ends with a primary 'Review template' button to the template review and a secondary 'Return to manage templates' button to Manage templates, in place of 'Review and submit' and 'Return to dashboard' (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 52; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:97-98)
Nothing on a template's task list or question pages links to Upload documents or the declaration (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 104-105; c-264)

For a notification, the Overview page still shows its status and reference, 'Notification tasklist', its Documents section, 'Review and submit' and 'Return to dashboard' (repo:frontend features/hub; trace:animals-fit hub buttons)
notes: Re-distil (9 October ruling): the criterion that Upload documents and the declaration redirect in template mode is withdrawn (c-264, claims 104-105): a template never offers them, and no guard is built. The task-list criteria no longer rest on the dropped whole-template edit trace (c-261); they are observed on a template being created.

Combines the commodity page in template mode (req-1326, req-1327), the template task list (req-1328 to req-1333) and the no-documents rule (req-1334): one set-up, a template being created, and one page the others return to. 'Review template' points at the review row's page; its target is observed once that row lands, so the review row follows straight after.
Combiner: keep the notification-hub area's req-814 to req-818 merged here, as before. A germinal template's task list (no Additional details task) is req-1876's.

rows.title: Review your template
rows.detail: 'Review template' opens a review page for the template in progress, with the template's sections and Change links straight to the question pages for the template being created. The review never leads to documents or the declaration; its main button saves the template (the save row).
acceptanceCriteria: The template review's Back link returns to the template's task list (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 68)

While a template is being created, the review's Change links open each question page directly to change the template in progress, such as Origin of the import and the contact address page, and that page shows the template-creation buttons, not 'Save and return' with a 'Cancel' back to a template page (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 68 LINKS; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 103)
notes: Re-distil: rewritten to this area's two requirements; Change links are named by page, never by ?from= markers (c-258).

Combiner: keep the review-and-submit area's req-941 and req-942 (the review page, its sections and no errors or arrival date) merged here as before: the same page. The review reuses the notification review's cards.

rows.title: Save a template and see it on Manage templates
rows.detail: 'Save template' stores the template, even part answered, and returns to Manage templates with a success banner and the new template first in the list. Each card shows its title and links to view or use it. Templates are kept by the backend between sessions and belong to the user who saved them (c-183, c-184). A template saved with no name is 'Untitled template'. A template is saved only by the form post (c-188).
acceptanceCriteria: The template review's 'Save template' button saves the template, even with only some sections answered, and returns to Manage templates with the new template first in the list and the count one higher, such as 'Show 1-1 of 1 results' (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 actions 72-78; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:166-169; c-188)

After saving, Manage templates shows a GOV.UK success notification banner with role alert, titled 'Success', headed '<template title> saved to templates' (prototype:dr2-1-source dashboard-templates.html:24-37; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 78; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:168)

The banner shows once: it is gone on reload; it does not dismiss itself and stays on the page, with or without JavaScript, until the trader leaves or reloads (prototype:dr2-1-source dashboard-templates.html:24-37; c-006)

A template saved with no name is titled 'Untitled template': the banner reads 'Untitled template saved to templates' and it is listed first (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T10 actions 14-16; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:174, 182)

Each template is a card labelled 'Template <title>' showing the template's category label above its title, which is an H3, with a 'View template' link to the template's page and a 'Use template' link (prototype:dr2-1-source partials/design-release-2.1/dashboard-template-card.html:2-11; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T1 actions 19-24; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:24-25)
With two templates saved one after the other, the list shows the later one first (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-012; c-183)
A saved template is still listed after the user signs out and signs back in (ruling:sam-2026-10-07 claim 10; c-183)
A template is private to the user who saved it: another signed-in user does not see it on their Manage templates and cannot open it (c-184)
A saved template never appears among the user's notifications on the dashboard (c-183)
notes: Re-distil (9 October ruling): the banner no longer dismisses itself after 5 seconds (c-006); the template-id-from-title criterion is withdrawn (req-1342 out of scope, c-259: how a template is identified is the backend's design); the ownership question is settled (c-184: private to the user who saved it), so the row carries no open question; req-1310 moved to the Manage templates row, where the store is built.

Combines saving (req-1340, req-1319), the success banner (req-1307, req-1308), the list order and card frame (req-1301, req-1302, req-1303) and privacy (req-1311): saving is the first moment a template exists, so each is first seen here. The 'Use template' link's target is built by the use row (req-1303's destination is observed there). The card's answer rows and category rule are in the card-answers row. The cross-user criterion uses a second test user, as the address book's cross-user spec does. The success banner pattern is reused by the delete, discard and change rows.
Combiner: the review-and-submit area's 'Save template' criterion (req-942) is the same button; it stays in inc-156.

rows.title: View a saved template
rows.detail: A saved template has its own page: its title as the heading, the date it was created, every saved answer in the same cards as the notification review with a Change link on each, and 'Use template' and 'Delete' buttons, with no Edit action (c-261). Opening the page of a template that does not exist or has been deleted goes back to Manage templates.
acceptanceCriteria: 'View template' opens the template page, with the caption 'Templates' above the template's title, which is its H1 and its page title ('<template name> - Import notification service - GOV.UK') (prototype:dr2-1-source view-template.html:8,46-47; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T3 actions 8-11; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:40-44)
The template page shows 'Date created: <d Month yyyy>' with the day the template was saved (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T3 action 12; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:45)

The template page has a primary 'Use template' button and a red warning 'Delete' button (prototype:dr2-1-source view-template.html:55-66; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T3 actions 13-14; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:46-47)
The template page's Back link goes to Manage templates (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-049; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T3 action 15; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:50)
The template page has no Edit button or link (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-050; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-055; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 82; c-261)

The template page lists the answers in the notification review's cards in five numbered sections, '1. About the consignment' (Origin of import, What are you importing?, Main import reason), '2. Description of the goods' (a card per commodity '<common name> (<code>)' with species, Number of animals, Number of packages when required, the identification details table, and an Additional details card), '3. Transport and arrival' (Arrival details and Transport details), '4. Consignment addresses' and '5. Contact address', with no documents section and a Change link on every card (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T3 actions 16, 20; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:38, 48-49)

A live animals template saved after answering every section shows on its page the country and region of origin, internal reference, commodity codes, common names and species, reason for import, purpose in the market, certified for, unweaned animals, animal and package totals and per-species numbers, net weight, package type, animal identification details, port of entry, means of transport, transport identification, transport document reference, the transporter's name, address, country, approval number and type, and the CPH number (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-041, p14-042; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T3 action 20)

Each card's Change link opens the change of that section of the saved template: origin of the import, what you are importing, reason for import, consignment details (on the commodity card header and its number-of-animals row), animal identification details, additional animal details, arrival details, transporter, roles and addresses and contact address (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T3 action 15; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 103)

Opening the page of a template that has been deleted, or of one that does not exist, goes to Manage templates (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-021; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T6 actions 11-12; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:84-85)
notes: Re-distil (9 October ruling): the 'posting to the template page' criterion is withdrawn (req-1355 out of scope, c-262); the Change links are named by section, not by change addresses (c-258); the not-found criterion no longer names an edit address (c-261) and covers the template page only. req-1345 (never an arrival date) moves to the change row, where both its halves (on save and after a change) can be seen.

Combines the template page (req-1347 to req-1353), what a saved template holds (req-1344, first observable on this page) and the not-found rule (req-1312). req-1312 also names the change, use and delete pages; each of those rows observes it for its own page as it lands (inc-159, inc-160, inc-165), since those pages do not exist yet when this row lands.
The Addresses and Contact address cards' party content is in the card-answers row (req-1346). The page reuses the notification review cards.

rows.title: Change one section of a saved template
rows.detail: A Change link on a template's page opens that section's question page prefilled with the template's answers, with only 'Save and return' and a 'Cancel' link. Saving updates the template, never a draft notification, resets its date created, and returns to the template page with a success banner. A template never holds an arrival date, before or after a change.
acceptanceCriteria: Following a Change link on a template's page opens that section's question page prefilled with the template's answers, ready to edit; an unanswered optional field is empty, never 'Not applicable' (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T5 action 14; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:64-71)

When changing a template section, the question page's only submit button is 'Save and return', beside a 'Cancel' link back to the template page, with none of the amend or journey buttons (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T5 actions 10-14; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:68-69; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-166)
When changing a template section, the question page's Back link returns to the template page (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T5 action 12)

Saving a changed section returns to the template page, which shows the new answer and a success banner titled 'Success' headed '<template name> has been updated'; the user's draft notifications on the dashboard are unchanged (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T5 actions 18-26; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:72-75)
A template with no name, once a section is changed and saved, shows the banner 'Template has been updated' (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-167)

The template page's banner shows once: it is gone on reload; it does not dismiss itself and stays, with or without JavaScript, until the trader leaves or reloads (prototype:dr2-1-source view-template.html:28-41; c-006)

Changing and saving each section the template page links to (origin, what you are importing, reason for import, consignment details, animal identification details, additional animal details, arrival details, transporter, roles and addresses and contact address) updates the template and returns to its page with the new answer (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-183; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T3 action 15)
After a section is changed and saved, the template page's 'Date created' shows the day of that save (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-040; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T5 action 26)

A template never shows or holds an arrival date or time: answering one on the arrival page while creating it, or while changing its arrival details section, leaves the template page with no arrival date or time (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-043, p14-043-m1; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T3 action 20)
Leaving a change part way and opening the template page again abandons it: the template keeps its saved answers (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-054)
The change of a template that has been deleted goes to Manage templates (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-021; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:84-85)
notes: Re-distil (9 October ruling): the section allow-list criterion is withdrawn (req-1357 out of scope, c-263); the banner no longer dismisses itself (c-006); 'Template has been updated' for an unnamed template and the every-section criterion added (req-1361); req-1345 moved here from the view row.

Combines the change journey (req-1356, req-1358 to req-1361), the template page banner and abandon rule (req-1354) and the date-created reset (req-1343), all seen only by changing a saved section, plus the arrival-date rule (req-1345), whose second half needs a change. Eleven criteria because each section's change is reviewed once; split by section only if the plan finds it too big.
The 'Save and return' and 'Cancel' actions change the shared save-actions chrome every question page uses, and take precedence over the amend ending (req-1358).

rows.title: Use a template to start a notification
rows.detail: 'Use template' creates and saves a new draft notification in the template's own set, seeded from the template's answers, and opens its normal notification task list with a new GBN-AG reference. The arrival date is left to answer, no documents are carried, and the new notification starts with no validation errors. Other drafts are left untouched (c-183).
acceptanceCriteria: 'Use template', from a live animals template's card or its template page, creates a new live animals draft notification and opens its task list headed 'Notification tasklist' with the status 'Draft' and a new GBN-AG notification reference made the same way as any new notification's; the new draft is listed on the dashboard and the user's other drafts are unchanged (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T4 actions 7-14; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:54-59; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 27, 51; c-183)

The new notification uses the set's normal task list, including '4. Documents' and '5. Consignment parties', ending with 'Review and submit' and 'Return to dashboard', and nothing on it names the template it came from (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T4 action 14)
Its overview shows the template's animal and package totals under 'Your commodities' (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T4 action 14)

It is seeded with the template's country of origin, region of origin ('Yes' with the code when the template has one, 'No' when not) and internal reference (blank when none) (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-062, p14-063)

It is seeded with the template's commodities and species, the commodity selections, animal and package numbers per species, net weight, package type and animal identification details (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-064 to p14-066; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 51)
It is seeded with the main reason for import, and with the purpose in the internal market only when the reason is 'Internal market' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-067)

It is seeded with 'Certified for' when the template's value is a valid option, otherwise 'Further keeping'; and with the unweaned animals answer when valid for the species, 'No' when the species have unweaned options and the template has none (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-068, p14-070; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 57)

It is seeded with the CPH number, port of entry, means of transport, transport identification and transport document reference, and leaves the arrival date empty, so Arrival details and Upload documents show 'To do' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-072; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T4 action 14)
It is seeded with the transporter's name, address, country, approval number and type (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-042; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T3 action 20; c-187)
It carries no documents and shows no validation errors when first opened (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-075)
Using a template that has been deleted goes to Manage templates and creates no notification (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-021)
notes: Re-distil (9 October ruling): the 'notification records the template's id and title' criterion is withdrawn (req-1366 out of scope, c-260); the notification starts in the template's own set (claim 51, c-266); req-1369 is now the live-animals half only (claim 57), so the storage-temperature seeding criterion leaves this row for the germinal half; the transporter-country question is settled (c-187), so the row carries no open question.

Combines every seeding rule (req-1363 to req-1365, req-1367 to req-1372): one action, one new notification, one set-up per check. Eleven criteria because the seeding rules are reviewed one by one; split only if the plan finds it too big.

Germinal: using a germinal products template, which starts a germinal products notification in the germinal set, is observed in req-1876's row once the germinal set exists; every criterion here is observed with a live animals template. Seeding party and contact addresses is in the card-answers row. Creating a seeded draft resembles copy-as-new: the plan may reuse the notification copy path.

rows.title: Template card answers, category and each party's address
rows.detail: Each template card lists Commodity, Origin, Consignee and Consignor and is labelled with the set the template was made in. A template saves each consignment party's address and the contact address as answered, shows them on its page, and seeds each back into a notification started from it, because the real notification persists and sends each party separately (c-186).
acceptanceCriteria: Each template card lists, in this order, Commodity (the commodity common names), Origin (the country of origin), Consignee (the consignee's name) and Consignor (the consignor's name), each reading 'Not applicable' when the template has no answer; a template saved with nothing answered shows 'Not applicable' for all four (prototype:dr2-1-source dashboard-template-card.html:15-34; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 78, T10 action 16; c-186)

A template made as a live animals template is labelled 'Live animals' on its card (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-014; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T1 action 24; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 51; c-266)

A template saves the place of origin, consignor, consignee, importer, place of destination and contact address each as answered, and its page's Addresses card (Place of origin, Consignor, Consignee, Importer, Place of destination) and Contact address card show each of them as the design renders them (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T3 action 20; c-186)
Where the contact address was not chosen, the template's Contact address card shows the place of origin, as the design does (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-045; c-186)
A notification started from a template has each party and the contact address seeded as the template holds them (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-071, p14-074; c-186)

sources.ref: T1 action 24; T3 action 20; T9 action 78; T10 action 16

notes: Re-distil (9 October ruling): the category is the set the template was made in, not worked out from its goods (c-266); the party-address question is settled (c-186, kept by claim 125), so the row carries no open question.

Combines the card's answer rows (req-1304), the category label (req-1305) and party addresses (req-1346): the card's Consignee and Consignor come from the same saved party addresses. Depends on the save, view and use rows, since its criteria are seen on all three.

Germinal: the 'Germinal products' half of req-1305 is observed in req-1876's row (a germinal template is saved and listed with that category) once the germinal set exists; here the label is observed for a live animals template, so the row needs no dependency on the germinal theme.

rows.title: Sort by select on Manage templates
rows.detail: Manage templates has a 'Sort by:' select built as Design Release 2.1 has it: four options, the current one preselected, outside any form and with no apply button. As in the prototype it does not reorder the list (c-185), so 'Arrival date' needs no meaning for templates.
acceptanceCriteria: Manage templates has a 'Sort by:' select with the options 'Select one', 'Newest first', 'Oldest first' and 'Arrival date', with 'Select one' preselected when no sort has been chosen (prototype:dr2-1-source dashboard-templates.html:63-74; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T1 action 24; c-185)
The select sits outside any form and has no apply button (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-009; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-016-m1; c-185)
With two templates saved, choosing any option leaves the list in its newest-saved-first order (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-009; c-185)
notes: Re-distil: c-185 now settles the sort question against the earlier default: the select is built as designed and does not reorder, so the row no longer needs the backend or the dashboard's sort pattern (dependency on inc-136 removed) and carries no open question. The select's name is the service's (c-258).
Kept apart rather than merged into the Manage templates row because its third criterion needs two saved templates (inc-157).

rows.title: Edit a whole saved template on its own task list
rows.detail: Dropped by the 9 October ruling: no page links to the whole-template edit mode, so it is not built. A saved template is changed one section at a time (inc-159).
acceptanceCriteria: Opening a saved template's edit address opens the template's task list ('Template tasklist', 'Template' tag and name) with the template's answers filled in (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:8551-8569; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:88-90)

Saving the edited template from its review overwrites it: the list count is unchanged, the template keeps its address, shows the changed answer, and is listed first (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:7751, 7808-7818)
The edit address of a template that does not exist goes to Manage templates (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:8556-8560)
notes: Dropped: ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 82 put req-1362 and req-1341 out of scope (c-261). Requirements kept as they were; the row covers nothing. The criteria are left as the row had them, for the record; the combiner may keep the row's earlier text unchanged.

rows.title: Discard a template being created
rows.detail: A template being created can be thrown away from its review, through the same 'Delete this template?' confirmation, without being saved. The confirmation uses the journey layout. The discard page shows only while a template is being created.
acceptanceCriteria: On the review of a template being created, the red warning 'Delete' button opens a page with the H1 'Delete this template?', a one-row summary list keyed 'Name' holding the name entered ('this template' when none), 'Confirm that you want to delete this template.' and 'This action cannot be undone.' (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T11 actions 14-21; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:185-195; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 103)
The discard confirmation's Back link and 'No, cancel' link go to the template review (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T11 actions 19-21; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:193-195)
The discard confirmation uses the journey layout, not the dashboard layout (prototype:dr2-1-source delete-template.html:1,23)

Confirming 'Yes, delete' throws the template away unsaved and returns to Manage templates, list and count unchanged, with the success banner '<template name> has been deleted' (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T11 actions 25-28; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:197-199)
Discarding a template with no name entered shows the banner 'Template has been deleted' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-087; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-185)

Opening the discard page when no template is being created goes to Manage templates, and confirming it then changes nothing and returns to Manage templates (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T12 actions 7-8; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:202-204)
notes: Re-distil: pages named by page (c-258, claim 103); the unnamed-template banner split into its own criterion so the reviewer checks the copy.

Combines the discard page (req-1380), its guard (req-1381), the outcome (req-1382) and the journey layout rule (req-1378, which the delete row's confirmation also keeps; observed for that page in inc-165). The prototype's unguarded discard post is not reproduced (req-1386 out of scope). req-1381 is kept: it is look and feel the trader can reach by Back, unlike the template URL guards claim 105 drops.

rows.title: Delete a saved template
rows.detail: A saved template can be deleted from its page through a 'Delete this template?' confirmation. Deleting removes it and returns to Manage templates with a banner.
acceptanceCriteria: The template page's 'Delete' button opens a page titled 'Delete this template? - Import notification service - GOV.UK' with the H1 'Delete this template?', using the journey layout (prototype:dr2-1-source delete-template.html:1,6,23; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T8 actions 8-11; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:102-107; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 103)

The confirmation shows a one-row summary list keyed 'Name' holding the template's title (prototype:dr2-1-source delete-confirmation.html:6-8; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T8 action 12; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:109)

Under the summary it says 'Confirm that you want to delete this template.' and 'This action cannot be undone.' (prototype:dr2-1-source delete-confirmation.html:9-11; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T8 actions 13-14; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:110-111)

It has a red warning 'Yes, delete' button and a 'No, cancel' link back to the template page, in a GOV.UK button group (prototype:dr2-1-source delete-confirmation.html:13-21; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T8 actions 15-18; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:112)
Its Back link goes to the template page (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-080; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T8 action 16; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:107)

Confirming 'Yes, delete' removes the template and returns to Manage templates with one template fewer in the count and the success banner '<title> has been deleted' (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T8 actions 22-29; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:114-117)
After deletion the template's page, and its delete confirmation, go to Manage templates (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-021; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-184)
notes: Re-distil (9 October ruling): the dependency on the dropped whole-template edit row (inc-163) is removed, and with it the criterion that the review's Delete goes to the delete confirmation for a saved template being edited: a saved template is never on a review any more (c-261). Pages named by page (c-258).

Combines the delete confirmation (req-1373 to req-1377), the outcome and banner (req-1379, req-1309). Depends on the view row (the Delete button) and the discard row (the shared confirmation page). Deleted templates are removed from the store, so the prototype's seeded-template resurrection does not arise (c-183).
Combiner: the review-and-submit area's req-943 (the review's Delete button) sat here before; with the edit mode dropped it is only the discard half, so consider moving it to inc-164.
